editor.name: Name
editor.author: Author
editor.changePantheon: Changing the pantheon clears the actions. Continue?
help.library.new: Creates an empty build and opens the editor.
help.library.import: Loads builds from a .json file exported by this site.
help.library.exportAll: Downloads all your builds in a single .json file (backup).
help.library.all: Clears the pantheon and god filter.
help.library.drop: Drag .json files here to import builds.
help.library.mine: Builds you created, saved in this browser.
help.library.presets: Ready-made builds that ship with the site. Read-only: duplicate to edit.
help.type.rush: Early attack to pressure the opponent.
help.type.eco: Economy focus: many villagers before fighting.
help.type.timing: A strong attack at a planned moment (e.g. right after an age up).
help.type.water: Build for water maps (fishing and ships).
help.editor.objective: The build's plan in a few words: what it tries to achieve.
help.editor.end: Where the build ends: an attack, an age, a unit. After that the game is up to you.
help.editor.settings: Simulation parameters for this build. Empty = default value.
help.editor.efficiency: How much of the theoretical gather rate villagers really achieve (walking, drop-off). 1 = 100%.
help.editor.tick: Simulation step in seconds. Smaller = more precise and slower.
help.editor.oracleRate: Favor per minute of each Oracle (0.6 moving to 3.4 standing with clear sight). The hero gives 44% more.
help.editor.norseFavor: The Norse earn favor by fighting. Estimate here the favor per minute from combat.
help.editor.popReserved: When a unit starts counting toward population: when training starts or when it leaves the building (as in game).
help.editor.window: “Train when affordable” does not spend resources reserved for timed actions within this window.
help.editor.sourceAmount: How much food this source has near the base. When it runs out, villagers move to the next one in the chain.
help.editor.foodChain: Order of food sources. Villagers sent to “food” use the first one that still has food. Drag to reorder.
help.editor.actions: The build steps, in order, with their start time. Drag to reorder; click to see the details.
help.editor.add: Pick the action type, then the unit, building or research. Click to add it at the end, or drag it to a position in the list.
help.editor.milestones: Key moments: time and resources at each.
help.editor.matchups: How the build fares against each god. Drag the portraits between columns, or click to change the rating.
help.palette.allAges: Shows items of every age. Use the icons to filter by age.
help.action.train: Trains units at a building. The cost is paid when each unit starts.
help.action.build: Builds a building with one or more villagers.
help.action.research: Researches a technology at a building.
help.action.age: Ages up, choosing the minor god.
help.action.move: Moves villagers from one resource to another.
help.action.timeShift: Moves a finished building elsewhere. It takes the building's build time; Palace, Sentry Tower and Mirror Tower cost 50% of their price. At most 2 at once.
help.action.autoTrain: Turns the auto queue on: the building trains the unit nonstop while resources last.
help.action.trainWhenAffordable: Trains the unit whenever resources are left over, without delaying upcoming timed actions.
help.action.event: Something the simulation does not compute: losing units in a raid, gaining favor or resources, or a note.
help.row.when: When the action starts: at a fixed time, as soon as the previous one starts, after another one finishes, or always (continuous rule).
help.row.rally: Where villagers go when they leave the building.
help.row.trainAt: Which building trains it. “Any” uses the first free one.
help.row.builder: Who builds: Automatic (an idle villager or one from the busiest resource), Take from a resource, New villager from an earlier training, or the Same builder as an earlier construction.
help.row.to: Which resource the villagers go to.
help.row.then: Where the builder goes when finished.
help.row.nearManor: Kronos: how many Manors are near the building. Each one speeds up construction by 25%.
help.row.minor: The minor god chosen on this age up.
help.row.lose: Units lost (e.g. in a raid). They free population.
help.row.gainFavor: Favor gained at once (e.g. Norse fighting).
help.row.note: A reminder shown on the timeline.
help.row.mode.asap: Starts as soon as the previous action in the list has started and resources allow.
help.row.mode.after: Starts when the chosen action finishes, plus the delay.
help.row.mode.always: Continuous rule, active from the start.
help.result.timeline: The build second by second: time, actions, population and villagers on food/wood/gold/favor.
help.result.warnings: Problems found by the simulation. Click a warning to jump to the action.
help.result.population: Population used and cap over time.
help.result.clicked: When the age up was clicked.
help.result.reached: When the new age was reached.
help.result.good: Matchups where the build is strong.
help.level.error: The action cannot happen as written (missing requirement, wrong id…).
help.level.delay: The action was delayed: missing resources, busy queue, population full…
help.level.info: Information: low-confidence data, food source depleted…
help.match.countdown: Countdown seconds before 0:00, to sync with the start of the match.
help.match.now: The current step of the build.
help.match.next: The next step and how long until it.
help.match.reset: Puts the clock back to the start.
help.settings.theme: Light, dark or the same as your system.
help.settings.sound: Beep in match mode 3 s before each step.
help.settings.tooltips: Shows these explanations when hovering titles.
help.settings.data: Where the game numbers come from.
help.settings.patch: Game version used for the data.
help.settings.api: JSON files with the standard builds and the data, for other sites to use.
help.tab.details: Type, author, objective, build end, simulation parameters and matchups.
production.title: Production
help.production.title: What each building is doing over time: training, research, age up, construction and Time Shift. Hover a bar to see start and end.
warn.cannotTimeShift: This building cannot be Time Shifted: {building}
warn.timeShiftLimit: At most {count} Time Shifts at once; waited {waited} s
help.action.promote.atlanteans: Turns the unit into a hero: stronger; a Citizen hero gathers and builds faster. A villager stops gathering for the 7 s of the promotion.
help.action.promote.gaia: Turns the unit into a hero. Gaia: the Citizen hero costs 25% less. A villager stops gathering for the 7 s of the promotion.
help.action.promote.norse: Turns a Gatherer (30 food + 20 gold) or a Dwarf (10 food + 30 gold) into a Berserk instantly. It stops gathering and joins the army. Needs 1 free population slot (a Berserk takes 2).
help.action.promote.loki: Turns a Gatherer or Dwarf into a Berserk instantly. Loki: half price (Gatherer 15 food + 10 gold; Dwarf 5 food + 15 gold). Needs 1 free population slot (a Berserk takes 2).
help.action.build.norse: Builds a building. Gatherers and Dwarves only build House, Farm and Ox Cart; everything else is built by infantry (pick the “Soldier” builder).
help.row.builder.norse: Who builds: Automatic, Take from a resource, New villager from an earlier training, Same builder as an earlier construction, or a Soldier (Berserk, Hersir…) for buildings Gatherers and Dwarves cannot build.
warn.noUnitToEmpower: No {unit} free to empower; waited {waited} s
help.action.empower: The Pharaoh empowers one building at a time: construction, research (age ups included) and military training ×1.75; resources dropped at the dropsite ×1.2; Monument favor ×1.2. Laborers, fishing ships and caravans do not train faster.
help.action.empower.ra: Ra: the Pharaoh empowers one building at a time (construction, research and military training ×1.75; dropsite and Monument favor ×1.2) and each Priest empowers one more building at 60% strength (×1.45 and ×1.12). Effects do not stack: on the same building the strongest counts.
help.action.empower.isis: Isis: the Pharaoh empowers one building at a time (construction, research and military training ×1.75; dropsite ×1.2). An empowered Monument makes double favor (×2).
help.action.summon.set: Set: the Pharaoh summons Animals of Set with favor (Baboon 3, Gazelle 3, Giraffe 5…). Tick “Hunt it” to kill the animal and add its food to the hunt (Gazelle 150, Giraffe 300).
help.row.by.ra: Who empowers: the Pharaoh (full effect) or a Priest (60% strength).
help.row.slot: Which Pharaoh/Priest (1, 2, …). Each empowers one building; empowering another one moves it.
help.row.huntIt: Kills the animal as soon as it appears: it takes no population and its food goes to the hunt.
help.action.train.greeks: Trains units at a building. Greek heroes have their own queue: they train without stopping villagers or the age up.
help.action.research.thor: Researches a technology. Thor: no Armory; each Dwarven Armory research gives 1 free Dwarf.
help.action.build.loki: Builds a building. Gatherers and Dwarves only build House, Farm and Ox Cart; everything else is built by infantry, which builds 10% faster with Loki.
row.invalidRef: action not found before this one
help.row.builderNewFrom: Which earlier training action provides the villager that will build. The action waits for that villager to be ready (e.g. “Train 3 Citizens” → the next one out builds).
help.row.builderSameAs: Which earlier construction: the same villager builds this one as soon as it finishes the other.
help.tab.gods: Pick the pantheon, the major god and one minor god per age.
help.tab.actions: Build it with the palette. Each action shows when it starts in the simulation.
help.tab.result: Milestones, what each building produces and the resource and population charts.
help.editor.events: Shows between the actions what happens on its own (units ready, buildings done, resources depleted) and the population.
help.editor.minors: The minor god picked when advancing to each age.
editor.startIdle.one: {count} starting villager is idle: use Move (from idle).
editor.startIdle.other: {count} starting villagers are idle: use Move (from idle).
warn.idleUntilEnd.one: {count} villager stayed idle until the end
warn.idleUntilEnd.other: {count} villagers stayed idle until the end
help.editor.view.list: The build actions in order, with the time each one starts.
help.editor.view.production: Bar chart over time: what each building is training, researching or building.
help.production.zoom: Time scale: the higher, the wider the bars.
help.palette.group.economy: The basics of every build: move villagers, train, build, research and age up.
help.palette.group.auto: Rules that keep running until turned off: auto queue and train whenever affordable.
help.palette.group.god: Powers and actions that depend on the chosen god.
help.palette.group.other: Notes on the timeline, such as a raid or lost units.
wd.noSpent: None: the wait was gathering only.
wd.onlyGathering: Gathering only, the missing {missing} {resource} take ~{s} s.
wd.spentDelay: The spends above ({total}) added ~{s} s to the wait.
help.warn.noResource: The action was ready, but the stock could not pay the cost; it waits until gathering covers the gap. To speed it up: put more villagers on that resource earlier or spend less of it before.
help.warn.queueBusy: The building was busy training or researching something else; the action starts when the queue frees up.
help.warn.popCapped: The unit was ready, but population was capped: it only leaves when there is room. Raise the population earlier.
help.warn.waitingRequirement: The action depends on something that was not ready yet (building, age or research) and waited for it.
help.warn.missingRequirement: A requirement (building, age or minor god) is never created by the build; the action does not start.
help.warn.idleWorkers: Villagers had nothing to do in this period. Use Move to send them gathering.
help.warn.idleUntilEnd: Villagers had nothing to do until the end of the simulation. Use Move (from idle) to send them gathering.
help.warn.neverStarted: The action never started before the simulation ended. The reason shown is what held it last.
help.warn.sourceDepleted: The source ran out and the villagers moved to the next one in the food chain (or went idle).
help.warn.lowConfidenceData: A number used here is uncertain in the data; the real match may differ.
help.warn.waitingBuilder: No builder was free; the construction waited for one to finish.
help.warn.notEnoughWorkers: Asked to move more villagers than that task had at the time.
help.warn.powerCooldown: The power was still recharging since its last use.
editor.clearMinorLater: Removing this age up also removes the later ages ({ages}). Continue?
help.editor.chainItem: Drag to change the priority (or use ← →). Drag it down, out of the list, to remove it.
help.editor.matchupGod: Drag to a column or click to change the rating.
help.editor.minorChosen: Picked. Click again to remove it (the build does not reach this age).
help.editor.minorPick: Click to pick this minor god when aging up.
